name: windy-plugin-croatian-buoys
description: Live Croatian DHMZ met-ocean buoy charts for Windy.com

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && mkdir -p docs && cp dist/plugin.js dist/plugin.min.js dist/plugin.json dist/screenshot.jpg dist/package.json docs/ && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
scripts.build:all-examples: for number in 01 02 03 04 05 06; do CONFIG=example$number SERVE=false rollup -c; done
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint

author: Community plugin
